Resolver.SourceUrl: https://www.techsmith.com/download/snagit/ (use the TechSmith Deployment Tool to generate the volume-licensed snagit.msi + snagit.mst transform, then stage BOTH in the package Files folder)

Installation.OfflineFallback: Stage the installer in the package Files folder to bypass the download.

Provenance.Notes: OFFLINE-ONLY / TRANSFORM-DRIVEN. Snagit 2025 is deployed with a volume-licence MST transform (TRANSFORMS=snagit.mst), as the legacy.SnagIt scripts did - the transform carries the licence key and configuration so users are not prompted to activate. Stage BOTH snagit.msi and the snagit.mst transform in Files\. The hand-edited Invoke-AppDeployToolkit.ps1 prompts the operator for transform-file choices when run interactively (build/pilot), and under Intune silent/SYSTEM context it auto-applies the single staged .mst (plain install if none staged). The install block was hand-authored to pass TRANSFORMS= - regenerating with -Force will overwrite that edit, so re-apply the transform logic after any regeneration.
